overview.short_description: A werewolf wandering in the dark forest longing for revenge.
overview.brief: Roger was once a human being. During a battle with the werewolf White Fang, he was killed by White Fang's sharp teeth and resurrected as a werewolf. Roger, who had been reborn, vowed to take revenge and eradicate the threat of the werewolves from this world.
overview.story:
Ignoring the villagers' warnings, Roger decided to settle right by the edge of the Black Forest, a mere few miles east of the Megalith Wastelands. His countless years in the imperial army had made him a man of strong resolve... and perhaps too stubborn for his own good. Regardless, now that his days as a soldier had passed, he was determined to hunt in the dark woodlands and live off of its bounty.

The Black Forest was home to all manners of unsavory vermin. But none was more terrifying than the hundreds of wolves prowling in the shadows. With their new Wolf King, Whitefang, having awakened ancient magic abilities within him, they became even more ferocious. And with the forest running out of prey, the wolves gradually expanded their hunting ranges and began to appear outside the woodlands. Always hunting in packs, they started attacking unwary travelers who dared to pass by.

Hell-bent on keeping this threat at bay. Roger tracked Whitefang's pack. ultimately finding them huddled around a small village. No sooner had he arrived than a guttural howl broke the quiet of the night. sending the pack of wolves in and ravaging everyone in their path.

The village erupted into chaos, with Whitefang himself standing in the middle, about to feast on an injured little girl. With no time to waste, Roger lunged straight at the beast and snatched the girl right out of his clutch. Whitefang snapped back, digging his claws into the hunter's chest as he attempted to deliver the girl to safety.

Undeterred by his wounds, Roger managed to push the vicious horde back, warning Whitefang never to return to the village with the same ferocity as the wolves'. The Wolf King did retreat with his pack, but when he looked back, Roger felt his blood turning ice-cold by the hatred in the wolf's eyes.

Haunted by the dread he felt that day, Roger couldn't stop worrying that Whitefang would come back for revenge. He began to train the surviving villagers in how to fight the wolves, particularly the little girl he rescued, whose name he later learned, was Ruby.

Before long, however, Roger noticed bizarre changes happening to his body. He suspected they were somehow related to the wounds Whitefang gave him. Worried about the safety of the others, the hunter fled the village in secret.

Returning to his home, Roger's suspicions were soon confirmed, as the ancient magic Whitefang carried had begun to infect his own body.

"Even one of a pure heart, one who misses not once his nightly prayers, is helpless to resist the lupine curse when the full moon looms in the night's sky."

The time soon arrived. When the gleam of the full moon illuminated the vast meadows around the Black Forest, Roger could do nothing but look on in horror as his body slowly shifted in shape, turning into a spitting image of Whitefang himself. Fearing that he would hurt those he swore to protect, he had no choice but to leave his home, embarking on a lone journey of his own.

abilities.name: Full Moon Curse
abilities.description:
Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms.

In human form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's current HP.

In wolf form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's lost HP.

This effect can only deal up to 60 additional damage against Creeps.

abilities.name: Open Fire
abilities.description: Roger fires two quick shots in the target direction, dealing 250/300/350/400/450/500<scaleAD> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> in total to the enemy hit. The first shot is a hunter net that slows the enemy by 80% for 1.5s, while the second is a bullet that reduces the enemy's Physical Defense by 10/14/18/22/26/30 for 5s.
abilities.flavor_text: Even one pure of heart can't escape the Full Moon Curse.

abilities.name: Lycan Punce
abilities.description: Roger lunges at the target enemy, becoming untargetable while dealing 250/300/350/400/450/500<scaleAD> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to up to 3 enemies in the area.</br></br>Getting a kill or assist will reduce the cooldown of this skill by 80%.
abilities.flavor_text: Even one pure of heart can't escape the Full Moon Curse.

abilities.name: Hunter's Steps
abilities.description: Roger gains 20/24/28/32/36/40% Movement Speed and 20/24/28/32/36/40% Attack Speed for 2.5s.

abilities.name: Bloodthirsty Howl
abilities.description: Roger lets out a howl, increasing his Attack Speed by 1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3/1.35/1.4 times for 5s. Within this duration, he gains 50% Movement Speed if an enemy hero below 40% HP is within his vision.

abilities.name: Wolf Transformation
abilities.description:
Roger lunges in the target direction and turns into wolf form, dealing 150/200/250/300 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 90% for 0.8s.

Passive: In wolf form, Roger gains 20/35/50/65 Physical & Magic Defense and 25 Movement Speed.

abilities.name: Restore Human Form
abilities.description: Roger rolls in the target direction and reverts back to human form, gaining a 200/250/300/350<scaleAD> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> shield for 1.5s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Roger's 1st Skill to whittle down enemies from afar while using his 2nd Skill to maintain good positioning. When both sides have engaged, use his Ultimate to go for the enemy's back line. Use his 2nd Skill for extra Attack Speed and his 1st Skill to secure the kill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Roger should poke the enemy while in his Human form. Use his 2nd Skill for extra Movement Speed for an angle to hit with his 1st Skill. Use his Ultimate to close in on the enemy, followed by his 2nd Skill for Attack Speed and tear into them with Basic Attacks before finishing them off with his 1st Skill.

relationships.description: Roger works best with heroes with high AOE damage that can nuke the enemy team to low HP for him to finish off, such as Pharsa and Vexana.
Roger counters squishy heroes that lack mobility such as Hanabi and Odette because they cannot easily escape from him.
Roger is countered by heroes that can restrict his mobility and prevent him from jumping in and out using his two forms, like Minsitthar and Khufra.
